Why does science fiction keep crucifying its chosen ones? Let's talk about the Space Jesus trope/messiah archetype that sci-fi & fantasy can't stop building and deconstructing. From Paul Atreides in Dune, to Anakin Skywalker, to Darrow in Red Rising, to Hadrian Marlowe in Sun Eater, this is why science fiction can't save its saviors ending the story of Christ in tragedy.
